mostWorthwhile.text: The matched water comparison was most worthwhile: it distinguishes faster exchange through aquaporin from the direction of net movement, while holding starting conditions constant.

leastWorthwhile.text: Installing each channel and then adding its transported substance made the sequence somewhat repetitive, especially when only one gameplay action was available.

surprise.text: The water comparison sharpened the distinction between movement in both directions and net movement toward the higher nonpenetrating-solute concentration; that direction remains the same when aquaporin speeds exchange.

arbitrary.text: No action felt purposeless: the membrane baselines and channel fittings supported the comparisons. The menu supplied compatibility, so these were not discoveries of recipes.

continue.text: I would probably continue for another chapter to see whether later constructions connect membrane transport to broader physiology. The comparison plans were clear, though the repeated fitting steps were less engaging.
